title: CozeCube Melange Brown Shaggy Bath Mat 24"x16" Non Slip Washable Rug | Upgraded For Bathroom, Super Soft Bath Rugs, Fluffy Plush Bathroom Rugs Machine Wash

【Highly Absorbent & Quick-Drying】 The dense microfiber and fluffy pile quickly absorb moisture, preventing unpleasant odors and keeping floors dry and clean—no more water damage or puddles.

【Durable & Easy Care】 Made from selected materials with meticulous craftsmanship, it retains its soft texture and durability even after many washes. Easy to maintain: gentle cold wash and low-temperature drying are recommended, and it regains fluffiness quickly even when air-dried.

【Versatile for Multiple Spaces】Available in various colors and sizes to match different home styles. Perfect not only for damp areas like bathrooms and kitchens, but also for living rooms, entryways, or pet zones—adding comfort and practicality to any scene.
